### 2026-10-10 – # Partway through coding opensky

**5.5h**

# Partway through coding opensky

I have ended up choosing Opensky as the API for my flight tracker, as it has a pretty good free tier. This allows me to get data around 400 times per day without signing up. I may add that later. It has been very painful to get this up, as figuring out what I actually have to code to connect to opensky is pretty difficult. I found a guide for using something called ESP32 http client, Which is made for esp32s and seems to be running pretty well. I have just started messing around with the screen.
